title: Electrodynamic Dust Shield payload tested on the Moon

tellings.quote: That's right. So, we're almost just over a year ago, we landed our our EDS payload had nine EDS's on there.

plain: A device meant to keep moon dust off equipment using electric fields, called an Electrodynamic Dust Shield, was landed and tested on the Moon, according to a NASA scientist named Charles Buhler who worked on it. He tells Michels that 'just over a year ago' they landed their payload carrying nine of these shields on the lunar surface.
